commitments.detail: Ensure all team members understand the meeting conduct rules enforced by the facilitator.
HR will maintain records of feedback submissions during the specified window.
HR will document and follow up on all concerns raised through the skip-level HR intake process.

Feedback will be collected through an anonymous form for 7 days.
An escalation route to HR for concerns involving direct managers will be established.
